en.t: The full text of the saibara song “Nukigawa” is as follows: “

units.source_text: （女唱）莎草生在贯川边，做个枕头软如绵。

en.t: (Woman singing) Sedge grows by the banks of the Nukigawa; made into a pillow, it is soft as cotton.

units.source_text: 郎君失却父母欢，没有一夜好安眠。

en.t: The young lord has lost his parents’ affection, and not one night can he sleep in peace.

units.source_text: （女唱）郎君失却父母欢，为此分外可爱怜。

en.t: (Woman singing) The young lord has lost his parents’ affection; for that very reason he is all the more dear and pitiful.

units.source_text: （男唱）姐姐如此把我爱，我心感激不可言。

en.t: (Man singing) Since my lady loves me so, the gratitude in my heart is beyond words.

units.source_text: 明天我上矢矧市，一定替你买双鞋。

en.t: Tomorrow I will go to the market at Yahagi, and I will surely buy you a pair of shoes.

units.source_text: （女唱）你倘买鞋给我穿，要买绸面狭底鞋。

en.t: (Woman singing) If you buy shoes for me to wear, buy ones with silk uppers and narrow soles.

units.source_text: 穿上鞋子着好衣，走上官路迎郎来。

en.t: I will put on the shoes, wear fine clothes, and go out onto the official road to welcome my lord.

units.source_text: ”源氏欲以此多情女子对比冷淡的葵姬。

en.t: ” Genji meant to contrast this affectionate woman with the cold Aoi.
